name: pathly
description: A React Native and Expo prototype for the Pathly transit app.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @pathly/mobile && npm run test --workspace functions
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build --workspace functions && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.1 deploy --only storage,functions
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build --workspace functions && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.1 deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.1 deploy --only hosting
